vo.text: Capture the station targets you have tuned, under a name you will recognise next season.
vo.next_text: A profile is a snapshot, so the work happens in the table before you save anything. Get the course reading the way you want it, hole by hole, and only then capture it.

vo.text: A profile is a snapshot, so the work happens in the table before you save anything. Get the course reading the way you want it, hole by hole, and only then capture it.
vo.previous_text: Capture the station targets you have tuned, under a name you will recognise next season.
vo.next_text: The Target VWC column is what a profile would capture. A profile stores one Target VWC per station and nothing else, no percent adjustments, no enable states.

vo.text: Open the Target Profiles tab in Settings.
vo.previous_text: The Target VWC column is what a profile would capture. A profile stores one Target VWC per station and nothing else, no percent adjustments, no enable states.
vo.next_text: Profiles sit with the calculation settings rather than in the table, because a target set is a calculation input rather than a station edit.

vo.next_text: Name a profile for the reason the targets are what they are: Summer Baseline, Tournament Week, Overseed Recovery.

vo.previous_text: Name a profile for the reason the targets are what they are: Summer Baseline, Tournament Week, Overseed Recovery.
vo.next_text: The count beside each profile says how many stations it covers. A profile holds every station the course had when it was captured, enabled or not.

vo.next_text: Stations added to the course later are not in it, and applying the profile leaves them untouched. Coverage is part of what a profile is.
